title: finding(pm): dispatch-gates never derives check:error-status-conformance for a diff under packages/**; the gate walks SCAN_ROOT = 'packages', a bare literal the hint extractor refuses, so a dev's local sweep passed a PR that CI then redded
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect in seat tooling, class (a)** (the "existing gate's population" class, ⛔ not a new gate). reach: measured on PR #22311.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `46d7554dc8` printed 71 commands without `check:error-status-conformance`.
- CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` then failed on exactly that family, for an emit site in `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`.

Found by objectstack-ai/objectstack#22283's dev (round-2 `os-dev-report` `6063587901`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021), `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ`. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## Position

- **How the derivation places this family:** only by four file literals. Its `--json` `artifactRosterSilences` lists `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts`, `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`, `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` and `scripts/error-status-unpinned-baseline.json`, with `coversYourPath: false`.
- **What the gate actually reads:** all of `packages/**`, through `const SCAN_ROOT = 'packages'` (`scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs:222`, walked at `:2099`). That bare single-segment literal is refused by the hint extractor by design (the bare-word / bare-root refusals in `dispatch-gates.mjs`).
- **The content-kind convention** that places `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` for a file carrying an ADR-0112 code does not name this family either.
- **The dev's sweep:** of the 11 gates with a bare `SCAN_ROOT = 'packages'`, only this one was both roster-silent and underived at that head.

## Direction (for triage)

The derivation's own roster footnote puts the fix on the gate's side: declare the scan surface beside the roster, in a subtree spelling the extractor accepts. Pin it with a positive control: a diff that adds a status-emitting site under `packages/**` derives the family. ⛔ No new gate.

Prior instance of the class: #21011 (closed). That one was `check:i18n-coverage`, whose population roots under `examples/` were undeclared.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` 「dispatch-gates derivation misses gate scan root packages bare literal artifact roster silent error-status-conformance not derived」. The nearest hits are #21011, #21697 and #20278, all closed and other families.

Dedupe words: dispatch-gates error-status-conformance not derived · artifact roster silent packages scan root · bare SCAN_ROOT hint refused
